meta.title: 🚀 Enhance Blog Experience: Pagination, Navigation & Better Discovery
meta.body_summary: Add pagination, year archives, featured posts, tag normalization, and browse components to debbie.codes blog, claiming 1.1s load time vs slow infinite scroll of 90+ posts.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot proposed blog pagination with 1.1s load claim; merged after multiple CHANGES_REQUESTED rounds addressing visual, functional, and test issues; no benchmark validation.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1140 changed lines across 21 files, this is a medium-sized frontend refactor by absolute volume. It represents a significant feature addition (pagination, archives, browse components) and was merged after iterative review fixes to address functional gaps and visual consistency.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer debs-obrien opened two CHANGES_REQUESTED reviews requesting: pagination verification with screenshots, year page fixes, featured posts display, reading time confirmation, tests, centering, tag normalization, duplicate tags, search across all articles, and year navigation discoverability.
review_details.performance_claim: Paginated blog loads in 1.1s compared to significantly slower with all 90+ posts loaded.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot required multiple iterations and explicit maintainer guidance to address functional, visual, and test shortcomings. The merge was enabled by persistent human review and incremental fixes rather than self-contained correctness.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer debs-obrien manually inspected deploy preview, provided screenshots, and requested specific feature fixes and centering; no profiler or load test was used.
detection_detail.ci_auto: No CI performance tests; later Playwright tests added but failed due to environment issues.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Pagination performance claim was not verified by maintainer or automated benchmark; only feature functionality was validated via manual review.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: All issues were addressed within the PR through multiple commit rounds; no revert or follow-up PR required.

core_change_summary.description: Introduced pagination with 12 posts per page, year archive pages, featured post section, reading time utility, tag normalization logic, and reusable BlogBrowseComponents; restructured blog homepage with Featured/Recent/Browse sections and linked to paginated full archive.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Tests were added but some failed due to Playwright environment issues outside the PR scope.
change_trajectory: Initial plan and full blog restructuring: pages, pagination, year archives, reading time.
First review feedback: pagination bug fix (BlogSearch overriding limit), year page route conflict, featured posts, reading time visibility.
Progress updates and patches to address remaining issues.
Second review feedback: centering, tag duplication, search scope, TypeScript errors, year navigation accessibility.
Added browse components and normalized tags; fixed centering and duplicate tags.
After final checkbox on centering/tags, PR merged.

review_signals.summary: First CHANGES_REQUESTED requesting screenshots for pagination, year pages, featured posts, and reading time, plus tests.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot addressed pagination bug, fixed year routes and featured posts in subsequent commits.

review_signals.summary: Second CHANGES_REQUESTED demanding centering, tag deduplication, search behavior, test fixes, and year navigation accessibility.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot normalized tags, centered titles, added browse components, and attempted test fixes.

review_signals.summary: After first round, maintainer acknowledged progress and requested remaining fixes.
Request to center browse titles and fix duplicate AI/MCP tags, with screenshot attachment.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot applied centering and improved case-normalization for tags.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with initial blog restructuring: pages, pagination, year, reading time.
~6.6h later maintainer CHANGES_REQUESTED pagination, year, featured, reading time, tests.
Copilot responded with a critial pagination fix and status update; maintainer asked to continue.
Copilot pushed fixes for featured posts, year routes, and reading time.
~3h later second CHANGES_REQUESTED centering, tags, search, tests, year navigation.
Copilot addressed all issues, added tests, browse components, and tag normalization.
After several days, maintainer requested final centering and tag deduplication; PR merged after fixes.
